verdict: No significant, material deterioration versus the baseline. The location and cause sections describe the background pattern of the (few) problem arrivals, not a new issue.

evidence: 82% of headway gaps at the target already existed at 6 Av.

Delay origin is mixed: 41% inherited upstream, 59% on the approach. Origins: on approach from 6 Av: 22, at or before Lorimer St: 15. Largest time loss on segment 6 Av -> target (median +90s vs schedule).
Time is lost a little at every stop (Lorimer St -> Bedford Av +77s, 14 St-Union Sq -> 6 Av +25s, 6 Av -> target +90s): a dwell-time / crowding pattern rather than one bad segment.
ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 107s on average vs 42s otherwise (2.5x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.
MTA reports 'Infrastructure & Equipment' as 40% of delays on line(s) L (1.1x the system share) in the analysed months.
14% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'police' alert was active for the line (problem rate 20% with an alert vs 15% without, lift 1.3x).
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 27% of delays on line(s) L (1.2x the system share) in the analysed months.
MTA reports 'Police & Medical' as 19% of delays on line(s) L (0.9x the system share) in the analysed months.

recommendations.action: Dwell-time programme at 8 Av and the stops before it during 20:00-21:00: platform controllers, door-closing announcements, step-back crews
recommendations.rationale: Run-time loss is spread across every stop on the approach, the signature of long dwells.
recommendations.expected_effect: Each stop recovers its excess dwell; the effect compounds along the line.

recommendations.action: Check whether scheduled dwell and run times on the approach still match observed loads; re-time the schedule if not
recommendations.rationale: A schedule with unrealistic dwells makes every train late by design.

recommendations.action: Prioritise infrastructure & equipment work orders on the L corridor near 8 Av
recommendations.rationale: Infrastructure categories over-index in MTA-reported delays for the line.

recommendations.action: Review dispatcher holding practice upstream of 8 Av; consider publishing hold reasons in the feed
recommendations.rationale: ETAs drift substantially before problem arrivals, indicating holds.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer discretionary holds; more accurate countdown clocks.

recommendations.action: Increase collection: record all stops (not only the target) and keep predictions to strengthen upstream/terminal lenses
recommendations.rationale: The available evidence does not isolate a cause.
recommendations.expected_effect: Better attribution in the next run.
